items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You did a record with Ernie Henry, right? Good alto player.

ctx.x: That was Wynton Kelly and that group? Ernie Henry. You did a record with Ernie Henry, right? Good alto player.
Yeah. Wynton’s a fine pianist. Oh dear. I think we were – I was supposed to marry him, but he died over there in Canada or somewhere.
